high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news or informational website. The content discusses a scientific discovery by physicists at the University of Vienna, working with researchers from the Vienna University of Technology. They have found a way to make graphene, a material known for its extreme strength and high conductivity, more stretchable. Text Content: The first paragraph explains that the scientists have made graphene more stretchable by adding tiny defects to the material and creating ripple-like patterns, similar to the folds of an accordion.
